cohort: 498 full term or late preterm neonates born in a tertiary care hospital in Taiwan between October 2013 and July 2014
finding: A 12-h specific TCB nomogram could be a useful reference for workup for hyperbilirubinemia, particularly when it is above the 95th percentile line.
mod_finding: This abstract does not examine mode of delivery as a factor in its analysis, although it does note that patient data regarding delivery mode was collected.
